seo.title: Anantara Vilamoura Algarve Honeymoon Review 2026
seo.description: 280-room Anantara golf-and-spa resort in Vilamoura. Score 82/100, from $400/night.

content.verdict: Anantara Vilamoura is the Thai-spa-heritage brand's Algarve outpost — 280 rooms with a strong wellness program in the Vilamoura golf estate, 20 min from Faro airport. The Anantara spa is one of the best in southern Iberia (the brand is famous for spa). The Victoria course at Vilamoura — a Dom Pedro Hotels golf course directly accessible — is one of the great Algarve rounds. The hotel is not on the beach but offers private beach club shuttle to Falésia beach. Caveats: 280 rooms is large, with corresponding kids-club presence. The architecture is competent rather than distinctive. Food is good but not Michelin. But for honeymooners who specifically want Anantara spa expertise and golf at a serious value below Conrad Algarve, this is the smart play. The Adults Only pool zone is a relief mid-day.
content.best_room: Deluxe Pool View Suite with terrace. Step up to the Spa Junior Suite for direct spa access. Avoid Deluxe Garden View — back-facing.

itinerary_7_nights.title: Arrival via Faro
itinerary_7_nights.description: 25-min FAO transfer. Check-in. Settle into Deluxe Pool View Suite. Sunset on the terrace. Dinner at Ria Formosa restaurant.

itinerary_7_nights.title: Spa day
itinerary_7_nights.description: Full Anantara spa hydrothermal circuit. Couples' Thai-style massage. Lunch at the spa cafe. Dinner at Emo Wine Bar.

itinerary_7_nights.title: Beach club
itinerary_7_nights.description: Shuttle to Falésia beach club. Beach morning. Lunch on the sand. Afternoon pool. Dinner at Ria Formosa.

itinerary_7_nights.title: Golf
itinerary_7_nights.description: Round at Victoria Vilamoura. Lunch at the clubhouse. Afternoon spa. Light dinner.

itinerary_7_nights.title: Benagil
itinerary_7_nights.description: Drive 1h west to Praia da Marinha. Cliff walk and Benagil view. Lunch at O Camilo. Return for spa. Dinner at the bar.

itinerary_7_nights.title: Tavira
itinerary_7_nights.description: Drive 45 min east to Tavira. Lunch on Ilha de Tavira. Final dinner at Emo.

caveats: Not beachfront — beach access by shuttle.
Food is good but not Michelin-level.
Family-friendly with kids-club; book non-school weeks.
Deluxe Garden View has no view — confirm category at booking.

faqs.question: Good for honeymooners?
faqs.answer: Good value choice for Anantara spa expertise and golf.

faqs.question: Book in advance?
faqs.answer: 2 months for Deluxe Pool View Suites.

faqs.question: Adults-only?
faqs.answer: No, but adult-only pool zone exists.

faqs.question: Best room type?
faqs.answer: Deluxe Pool View Suite or Spa Junior Suite. Avoid Garden View.
